title: Barriers to GenAI Integration During Large-Scale Agile Transformation: An Exploratory Case Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.25967v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Organizations undergoing large-scale agile transformations are increasingly introducing generative AI (GenAI) tools into everyday work. While GenAI promises to accelerate software development, less is known about how organizations integrate GenAI into existing large-scale agile ways of working and how it interacts with tensions related to autonomy, alignment, learning, and coordination. We examine barriers to GenAI integration through an exploratory case study of a large Nordic media organization undergoing a large-scale agile transformation. The findings reveal team-level barriers, including diverging AI beliefs, lack of shared practices, and limited experimentation capacity, and organizational-level barriers, including uneven AI maturity, weak organizational learning mechanisms, and cross-unit coordination and alignment challenges. translated_title: 大规模敏捷转型中生成式AI整合的障碍：一项探索性案例研究
translated_abstract: 正在进行大规模敏捷转型的组织正日益将生成式AI（GenAI）工具引入日常工作之中。尽管GenAI有望加速软件开发，但人们对组织如何将GenAI整合到现有的大规模敏捷工作方式中，以及它如何与自主性、一致性、学习和协调等方面的张力相互作用，仍知之甚少。我们通过对一家正在进行大规模敏捷转型的大型北欧媒体组织开展探索性案例研究，考察了GenAI整合所面临的障碍。研究结果揭示了团队层面的障碍，包括AI观念分歧、缺乏共享实践以及实验能力有限；以及组织层面的障碍，包括AI成熟度不均衡、组织学习机制薄弱以及跨单元协调与对齐方面的挑战。我们的研究结果表明，GenAI并不会创造新的组织挑战，而是与现有的组织问题交织在一起……
tldr: 本研究通过对一家大型北欧媒体组织的探索性案例研究，揭示了大范围敏捷转型中生成式AI整合所面临的团队层面（AI观念分歧、缺乏共享实践、实验能力有限）与组织层面（AI成熟度不均衡、学习机制薄弱、跨单元协调对齐困难）的双重障碍。
en_tdlr: This exploratory case study of a large Nordic media organization reveals that GenAI integration during large-scale agile transformation faces team-level barriers (diverging AI beliefs, lack of shared practices, limited experimentation) and organizational-level barriers (uneven AI maturity, weak learning mechanisms, cross-unit coordination and alignment challenges).
